note: Art bible and size table for every model the world needs. Mesh workers build TO these sizes (within 10%, report the measured size); the map places BY these sizes. Sizes are [x, y, z] studs, the model standing on y = 0, centred on x and z, its front facing -Z. One Roblox character is 5.5 tall and 4 wide.

style.name: Toy-block anime festival
style.why: The owner played the greybox and called it plain. The genre's hit games are bright, chunky and readable from far away. This is our own version of that: a toy diorama, not realism.
shape: big simple volumes with bevelled edges (0.15 to 0.3 stud chamfers), never razor-sharp boxes
exaggerated, friendly proportions: fat posts, oversized roofs, thick rims, rounded tree crowns built from a few chunky lobes
nothing thinner than 0.4 studs; it must read from 80 studs away and on a phone
a darker base lip and a lighter top band on most objects, so they sit on the ground and catch the eye
every model is one closed, clean piece of geometry per colour: no stacks of visible primitive boxes, no z-fighting faces
colour: saturated flat colours, 3 to 5 per object, no textures; each colour becomes one MeshPart
the zone's key colour appears on every prop of that zone as trim
white keyline accents and warm yellow highlights tie the whole world to the UI (plan/05)
wood #B5793F and #8A5A2B, stone #9AA4B2 and #6B7686, grass #5BD43A and #46B82C, sand #F4D58A, water #38BDF8, ink #0D0F2B
style.accent_convention: Lane_ZoneGate and Plot_Pedestal carry ONE colour that the game recolours at build time (the zone colour, the rarity colour). Author that colour as exactly #FF00FF so the builder can find the part; nothing else may use #FF00FF.

Lane_ZoneGate.look: GRAND anime shrine gate spanning the whole lane corridor (the owner called the first gate small and lame): two massive pillars on carved stone plinths, an opening at least 44 wide and 20 high, two stacked curved roof beams with upturned gold-tipped ends, a thick twisted shimenawa rope with paper tassels hanging under the lower beam, a big blank banner board in the middle for the zone name (one clean quad facing -Z, about 22 x 4.5), a hanging paper lantern on each side, guardian fox statues on the plinths. Trim, pillar bands and lantern glow in the #FF00FF accent. This is the first thing a player sees when they throw: make it the richest piece in the kit. Budget 6000 triangles.

The top standing surface is flat and at exactly y = 3. Budget 3000 triangles.
